msg: Y para transferência tiene descuento? Tengo cuenta local
reply:
There is no discount for paying by bank transfer or for having a local bank account. The price is the same; the 10% discount applies when you book online directly with us.

For *Fun Dives – 2 dives (1 day)*, the prices are:
• From Cartagena: 630.000 COP online or 700.000 COP without booking online.
• If you’re already on the Rosario Islands: 440.000 COP online or 489.000 COP without booking online.

As a resident of Colombia, you can pay in pesos: either 100% online, or 50% online and 50% in person by card or cash. A team advisor arranges the payment in this chat when closing the booking.

• 10% discount when booking online directly with us through our website, not through third parties like PADI. This is the standard online discount and is applied automatically when booking on the web.
• 10% discount for groups of 5 or more people, which stacks with the 10% online discount (20% total when booking online). Not applied automatically: the group must contact the team to apply it. It must be requested from the team BEFORE paying: if the group pays without having requested it, the discount is lost (it is not refunded afterwards). Applies to recreational diving, mini-courses and snorkeling; does not apply to PADI courses. For the companion plan (someone who rides the boat without diving or snorkeling), whether it counts for the group discount is confirmed by the team when the discount is requested, before paying.
• 5% discount if you bring your own COMPLETE gear (regulator, BCD, wetsuit, mask, fins, etc.), only for recreational diving and PADI courses: it does not apply to the mini-course or snorkeling, even with complete gear. It also does not apply if you only bring part of the equipment.
• Colombian clients and residents pay in Colombian pesos (COP). International clients pay in US dollars (USD). There is no special discount for being Colombian; the price is the same, only the currency changes.

Would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Then I'll send you the exact plan and booking link. 🌊

reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

The Rosario Islands are a beautiful place for a two-day dive trip. Since you’ll be in Cartagena, there are two options:

- *4 dives over 2 days:* 4 daytime dives, *USD 316 online* or USD 351 regular. You stay one night on the islands; accommodation isn’t included. Lunch is included on day 1 only.
- *5 dives over 2 days:* 4 daytime dives plus 1 night dive, *USD 392 online* or USD 436 regular. You also stay one night on the islands; accommodation isn’t included. Lunch is included on day 1 only.

Both include boat transport from Cartagena and diving gear, and require certification. The 4-dive option returns to Cartagena on day 2 at 3:00 p.m. (estimated arrival around 4:15 p.m.), so it wouldn’t fit a departure on the morning of the 15th. The 5-dive option also returns on day 2, so it wouldn’t fit that morning departure either. You’d need to adjust your travel plans or ask a team advisor about possible arrangements.

For the trip, bring your swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses, comfortable clothes, and your certification card. The meeting point is *Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.*, about five minutes from the historic center. There’s no hotel pickup in Cartagena, so you’ll need to get to the dock yourself; ground transport isn’t included. You’ll also need to complete the insurance form sent with your booking confirmation. After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying.

Your dates are April 13–14, but the package returns to Cartagena on the 14th afternoon. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to discuss your morning departure on the 15th?

You'll also need:
• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly.

msg: Y a qué hora se vuelve a Cartagena?

*Desde Cartagena:* Muelle de la Bodeguita, a 5 minutos del centro histórico, a las 8:00 AM. Saliendo desde Cartagena no hay recogida en el hotel: cada persona llega por su cuenta al muelle (el transporte terrestre hasta el muelle no está incluido).

*Si ya estás en las Islas del Rosario:* Si ya estás en las Islas del Rosario y tu hotel tiene acceso marítimo, la recogida y el regreso en lancha están incluidos sin cargo adicional. Si ya estás en las Islas del Rosario, coordinamos recogida y regreso desde hoteles con acceso marítimo. En algunos casos la lancha llega directo al hotel; en otros te indicamos el muelle o punto más cercano.

Los cursos de 2 días (Open Water, Curso Referido, Advanced) requieren alojamiento en las islas: al menos una noche, la del día 1 (el día 1 no se vuelve a Cartagena). Lo mismo en los paquetes de buceo de varios días (4, 5, 7 y 9 inmersiones): se duerme en las islas y el alojamiento, que no está incluido, se reserva directamente con el hotel.
